title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

  • Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

  • In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

  • In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

  • In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

  • Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

  • Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

  • Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

  • Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

  • Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

  • Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

  • Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

  • Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

title: Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant

Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant

You will become part of our kitchen team and work closely with the kitchen management and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations, consistent quality and a high standard of food preparation.

The position is full-time and includes both preparation and cooking duties. We are looking for a reliable and professional employee who can work independently, cooperate with colleagues and contribute positively to the development of our kitchen.

Your duties will include, among other things:

  • Preparing and cooking authentic Thai and Asian dishes according to the restaurant’s recipes and quality standards.

  • Ensuring consistent taste, quality, portion sizes and presentation.

  • Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient kitchen station.

  • Assisting with daily preparation and service in both smaller and larger kitchen operations.

  • Following instructions from kitchen management regarding production, preparation and daily priorities.

  • Monitoring stock levels and informing management when ingredients need to be ordered.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

We are looking for a dedicated and well-organised Cleaning Supervisor to join our dry-cleaning business at Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V.

  • Identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Ensure daily tasks are completed on time while maintaining a well-organised and efficient working environment.

  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience in a dry-cleaning, laundry, cleaning or similar service business.

  • Is organised and capable of coordinating daily operations.

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

title: We Are Hiring – Experienced Chef
description:
EU/EEA citizenship or valid right to work in Denmark required

Ærø Hotel is looking for an experienced, skilled and reliable Chef to join our international kitchen team.

We are located on the beautiful Danish island of Ærø, in the maritime town of Marstal. We are looking for an experienced chef who enjoys working in a structured professional kitchen, preparing good-quality food for a large number of hotel guests.

We have 1 position available.

About the position

You will become part of our evening kitchen team, which consists of five chefs working closely together.

Ærø Hotel does not operate an à la carte restaurant.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers
description:
The Centre for Industrial Mechanics in Sønderborg, Denmark, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year postdoc position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers. The position is open from October 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

 

About the Position

The position is funded through a collaborative research and innovation project involving SDU, DTU, and Stiesdal Hydrogen, and aims to reduce the CAPEX of green hydrogen production by developing a next-generation bipolar electrode cassette for alkaline electrolysers. One focus will be on geometry-driven bubble management.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will join the SDU Energy Systems Group at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM) and play a key role in developing advanced simulation tools and validating simulations with experimental results. Your work will combine multiphase CFD modelling, current distribution modelling, and collaboration with experimentalists. The objective is to create predictive models that guide cassette design, identify optimal operating conditions, and reduce the need for extensive physical prototyping.

Working closely with researchers at SDU and DTU, as well as engineers at Stiesdal Hydrogen, you will contribute to the development of next-generation hydrogen production technology with clear industrial impact and support its path towards large-scale implementation.

 

Your Role

  • Develop and apply simulation methods for multiphase transport and current distribution 

    in electrolyzers

  • Investigate bubble-buoyancy-driven internal electrolyte circulation

  • Quantify transport processes affecting mass transfer and electrochemical performance

  • Integrate computational and experimental results to advance mechanistic understanding and predictive modelling

  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners

  • Mentor and supervise students (PhD, MSc, BSc) on related research questions

  • Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences

  • Contribute to research funding applications and assist with teaching activities as relevant

 

Your Profile

  • PhD in engineering, computational science, physics or related discipline

  • Background in computational fluid dynamics (CFD)

  • Experience in multiphase flow and/or electrochemical transport modelling

  • Experience with numerical simulation software such as ANSYS, COMSOL, or OpenFOAM 

  • Programming skills in Python, C++, or equivalent languages

  • Strong teamwork, communication, and independent research skills

  • Proficient in English (spoken and written)

 

Why Join SDU Sønderborg?

The SDU Energy Systems Group at CIM is a dynamic, recently established research group within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). As part of a young and growing team and institute, you will help shaping research, education, and innovation in engineering science. 

You will have access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities, and benefit from strong academic and industrial networks across Denmark and Europe. CIM is based at SDU’s scenic Sønderborg campus in the Alsion building directly at the waterfront. All study programs are taught in English, and more than half of our students and staff are international, creating an inspiring environment.

SDU maintains close ties to industry in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany, offering direct exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities for cross-sectoral research collaborations. This position offers you the chance to develop your own research ideas, contribute to the growth of the group and institute, and advance your career in a supportive, international setting.

In short, you will benefit from:

  • Access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities

  • A dynamic, international research environment in a scenic campus setting

  • Close ties to industry and opportunities for cross-sectoral collaboration

  • Support for developing your own research ideas and career

 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Martin Lautenschläger 
(mlaut@sdu.dk; phone: + 45 65 50 79 86) or Associate Professor Lars Duggen (duggen@sdu.dk) and visit www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 2026. The start date may be adjusted to comply with processing times for any work- and residence permits.  Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
SEO Specialist

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. Tools Experience with some of the following tools is preferred: • Google Search Console; • Google Analytics; • Ahrefs / Semrush; • Screaming Frog; • Google Keyword Planner; • PageSpeed Insights.

Option to work from home: Yes

Vaheldusrikas ja arendav töö toetavas ning kokkuhoidvas meeskonnas

Tööülesanded: Oled hooliv, vastutustundlik ning hindad meeskonnatööd ja arengut?
Siis on see ametikoht Sulle! Sinu töö eesmärgiks on arendada ja säilitada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti! Kvaliteetse tulemuse saavutamiseks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - eluks vajalike oskuste õpetamine (nt eelarve koostamine); - tööalane nõustamine ja juhendamine; - saatmine arsti külastamisel; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine; - huvijuhi abistamine ja asendamine (päevakeskuse tegevuste läbiviimine); - väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ning nendel osalemine; - kolleegide asendamine. Kliendiga vahetult tehtud töö (vestlused, kodukülastused) tuleb elektrooniliselt dokumenteerida. Sa vastutad Sulle määratud klientidele vahetult osutatava teenuse osutamise eest, koos sellega kaasneva aruandluse korrektse täitmisega. Lisaks oled asendusvajaduse korral abiks päevakeskuses või töötubades. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda (sh ühistranspordiga) - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena.
Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja vestlused. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vabade päevade võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga.

Muud nõuded: Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida korras oma vaimset tervist. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel. Juhul, kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

• eelnev töökogemus sotsiaal- ja/või hariduse valdkonnas, kursisolek valdkondlike õigusaktidega, teadmised tööst peredega ja kaasava hariduse põhimõtetest; • suurepärane suhtlemisoskus ja koostööle orienteeritus, lahendusmeelsus, algatusvõime ning järjekindlus • väga hea eesti keele oskus kõnes ja kirjas, soovitatavalt inglise või vene keele oskus suhtlustasandil.

title: Raskaan kaluston mekaanikko
description:
Haluatko työskennellä Euroopan markkinajohtajan parissa kuljetusalan leasing- ja huoltopalveluissa? TIP Group tarjoaa ratkaisuja kuorma-autoille, perävaunuille ja muille kuljetusvälineille. Autamme asiakkaitamme pitämään kalustonsa liikkeessä tarjoamalla joustavia leasing-, vuokraus- ja huoltoratkaisuja eri puolilla Eurooppaa.



Olemme laajentamassa Lieton korjaamotoimintaamme perävaunuista myös kuorma-autojen huoltoon ja korjaukseen. Tästä syystä etsimme kokenutta raskaan kaluston mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tässä roolissa toimit Lieton toimipisteen ensisijaisena kuorma-automekaanikkona. Työ edellyttää vahvaa ammattitaitoa, kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä halua ottaa vastuuta päivittäisestä tekemisestä.

Jos sinulla on kokemusta kuorma-autojen huolloista ja korjauksista sekä haluat työskennellä osaavassa ja mutkattomassa työyhteisössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.



Tehtäväsi

Työssäsi vastaat pääsääntöisesti kuorma-autojen sekä tarvittaessa myös perävaunujen ja muun raskaan kaluston huolloista, korjauksista ja tarkastuksista, kuten:

Tarkastukset ja määräaikaishuollot
Vianmääritys ja korjaustyöt
Kaluston turvallisuuden, käyttövarmuuden ja liikennekelpoisuuden varmistaminen
Yhteistyö asiakkaiden sekä oman tiimin kanssa



Mitä tuot mukanasi

Vahvaa kokemusta erityisesti kuorma-autojen huolloista, korjauksista ja vikadiagnostiikasta
Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ottaa vastuuta päivittäisestä tekemisestä
Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
Kykyä työskennellä myös kiireisissä tilanteissa huolellisuudesta tinkimättä
Positiivista asennetta ja hyvää huumorintajua

Eduksi katsomme C-ajokortin sekä kokemuksen perävaunutekniikasta, jarrujärjestelmistä sekä sähkö- ja hydrauliikkajärjestelmistä.


Miksi TIP?

Meillä pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja ammattitaidon kehittämiseen panostetaan. Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työnkuvan, nykyaikaisen työympäristön sekä ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Osaamisen kehittämistä tuemme koulutusten ja käytännön työn kautta.

Vaikka kuorma-autojen huoltotoiminta on Lietossa uutta, työskentelet osana kokenutta korjaamotiimiä, jossa arvostetaan yhteistyötä, osaamisen jakamista ja yhdessä onnistumista. Arjessamme yhdistyvät vahva ammattitaito ja hyvä tekemisen meininki.



Tarjoamme mm.:

Vakituisen työsuhteen kasvavassa kansainvälisessä yrityksessä
Tukea ammattitaidon kehittämiseen ja osaamisen ylläpitämiseen
Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen
Kattavan vakuutusturvan
ePassi-edun
Globaalin työntekijöiden tukiohjelman
Hedelmiä työpaikalla
Kannustavan, ammattitaitoisen ja käytännönläheisen työyhteisön

Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan pitämään asiakkaidemme kalusto liikkeessä!
Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Tietohallintosuunnittelija 40.12
description:
Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on Keskusrikospoliisissa toimiva Rahanpesun selvittelykeskus ja sen IT- ja analyysiryhmä.

Rahanpesun selvittelykeskus ottaa vastaan ilmoitusvelvollisilta epäilyttäviä liiketoimia ja terrorismin rahoittamista koskevia ilmoituksia sekä analysoi ja luovuttaa oleellista tietoa muille viranomaisille Suomessa ja ulkomailla. Ilmoitukset otetaan vastaan sähköisesti erikseen tarkoitukseen varattua sovellusta käyttäen, joko käyttöliittymän tai xml-ilmoittamisen kautta.

Tehtävässä pääset toteuttamaan itsenäisesti sekä yhteistyössä kollegoiden kanssa selvittelykeskuksen hallinnoimien tietojärjestelmien kehittämistä. Erityisvastuunasi on rahanpesurekisterin käyttöliittymän tuoteomistajuus, jonka osalta toimit myös johtavana asiantuntijana. Lisäksi pääset tekemään yhteistyötä rahanpesun torjuntaan liittyvien sidosryhmien niin kansallisesti kuin kansainvälisesti. Samalla tutustut rahanpesun torjunnan monisyiseen maailmaan.

Vastuullasi on erityisesti:
- Rahanpesun selvittelykeskuksen hallinnoimien tietojärjestelmien suunnitteluun (käyttöönotto ja elinkaari) ja kehittämiseen liittyvät tehtävät;
- rahanpesurekisterin käyttöliittymän tuoteomistajana sekä johtavana asiantuntijana toimiminen;
- yhteistyö tietojärjestelmiin ja tietoliikenteeseen liittyvien palveluntarjoajien kanssa;
- epäilyttäviä liiketoimia koskevaan ilmoittamiseen liittyvien teknisten ongelmatilanteiden ratkaiseminen;
- yhteistyö ilmoitusvelvollisten kanssa
- kansallinen ja kansainvälinen yhteistyö rahanpesun torjunnasta vastaavien viranomaisten kanssa.

title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

title: Hitsaaja / korjaaja – raskaan kaluston korjaustöihin
description:
Etsimme vahvan ammattitaidon omaavaa hitsaajaa/korjaajaa itsenäiseen ja monipuoliseen työhön pajallemme.

Työ painottuu raskaiden maanrakennuskoneiden lisävarusteiden korjauksiin, vaativiin hitsaustöihin sekä erilaisiin koneiden ja rakenteiden korjauksiin. Työssä pääset tekemään vaihtelevia ja käytännönläheisiä töitä, joissa ammattitaidolla, ongelmanratkaisukyvyllä ja itsenäisellä työotteella on suuri merkitys.

Työhön voi kuulua myös työmailla tehtäviä keikkoja sekä komennusluonteisia töitä, joten valmius matkustamiseen katsotaan eduksi.

Odotamme sinulta

- Vankkaa hitsaus- ja korjauskokemusta

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä

- Kokemusta raskaasta kalustosta, maanrakennuskoneista tai niiden lisävarusteista

- Hyvää ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja käytännönläheistä asennetta

- Huolellista ja turvallista työskentelytapaa

- Valmiutta tarvittaessa keikka- ja komennustöihin


Koulutusta tärkeämpää meille on käytännön osaaminen ja se, että hommat tulevat kunnolla tehdyiksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn

- Itsenäisen työnkuvan

- Haastavia ja ammattitaitoa vaativia hitsaus- ja korjaustöitä

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä sekä pajalla että työmailla


Päihteettömyys

Edellytämme työntekijältä päihteetöntä ja asiallista työotetta. Alkoholin käytön ei tule aiheuttaa ongelmia työssä tai työkyvyssä, jamuiden päihteiden käyttöä emme hyväksy.

Jos olet kokenut tekijä, joka osaa hitsata, korjata ja ratkaista ongelmia itsenäisesti, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Kiinnostuitko? Ota yhteyttä ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi.

title: Lvi-asentaja huolto ja saneeraustöihin
description:
Haemme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Lvi-asentajaa. Päivittäiset työtehtävät muodostuvat vaihtelevissa kohteissa lvi-huoltotöistä, remonttikohteista, saneeraustyömailla työskentelystä kuin myös uudistyömailla työskentelystä. Kuitenkin pääsääntöisesti huolto- ja remonttikohteiden parissa. Niin taloyhtiökohteissa kuin yksityisasiakkaiden luona sekä remonttialan yritysten kanssa. Myös urakkatyöt ovat mahdollisia.

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, oman työauton käyttöösi, nykyaikaiset työkalut, rennon ja rempseän työyhteisön pienessä porukassamme. Lisäksi voit käyttää vapaa-aikanasi yhtiömme tiloja omiin pieniin hommiisi. Tarjoamme myös vuosittain henkilökunnallemme, niin liikunta kuin hierontapalveluja lahjakorttien muodossa.

Toivomme sinulta: Tarkkaa ja tarmokasta otetta työhösi sekä luonnollisesti hyvää ammattiosaamista. Hitsaustaito luetaan eduksesi. Ymmärrys lämpöpumppu- ja kaukolämpölaitteista luetaan myös eduksesi. Olethan valmis myös oppimaan uutta sillä pyrimme aina mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös tarjoamaan kouluttautumista henkilökunnallemme.

Paikka täytetään heti kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä meihin niin sovitaan haastatteluaika ja istutaan kahvin kanssa katsomaan että olisiko juuri sinusta meille tuleva asentaja. Meillä ei tarvitse pokkuroida vaan kohtaamme jokaisen haastateltavan omana itsenämme ja arvostamme jokaista hakijaa.

title: Lähihoitajan sijaisuus, Vammaispalvelut, Koskelan asumisyksikkö, Paimio
description:
Haluatko tehdä työtä, jossa jokaisella kohtaamisella on merkitys? Koskelan asumisyksikössä Paimiossa pääset osaksi lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa tuet kehitysvammaisten asukkaiden turvallista, sujuvaa ja arvokasta arkea. Etsimme pitkäaikaiseen sijaisuuteen lähihoitajaa vuoden 2026 loppuun saakka.

Tehtäväsi

Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme arkea ja hyvinvointia. Työssäsi huolehdit asiakkaiden päivittäisestä ohjauksesta, hoidosta ja yksilöllisten tarpeiden toteutumisesta yhdessä sovittujen suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Kohtaat jokaisen asukkaan yksilönä ja toimit heidän osallisuuttaan tukien.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös lääkehoidon toteuttaminen lääkärin määräysten ja yksikön lääkehoitosuunnitelman mukaisesti sekä muu terveydenhuollon toteuttaminen. Työ sisältää syvästi kehitysvammaisten asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa sekä mielekkään ja turvallisen arjen mahdollistamista erilaisten toimintojen avulla.

Työvuorot ovat sovittavissa, ja työ on kaksi- tai kolmivuorotyötä.

Koskelan asumisyksikkö on koti 12 kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle, jotka tarvitsevat paljon tukea päivän eri toiminnoissa. Yksikössä vallitsee rauhallinen ja turvallinen ilmapiiri. Suurin osa asukkaista liikkuu avustettuna tai apuvälineiden avulla. Vuonna 2016 valmistunut Koskela tarjoaa viihtyisän, valoisan ja esteettömän työympäristön keskellä kauniita maalaismaisemia.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle
- Merkityksellisen työn kehitysvammaisten asiakkaiden parissa
- Lämminhenkisen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen
- Moniammatillisen tiimin, jossa jokaisen osaamista arvostetaan
- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuorojen suunnitteluun
- Pitkäaikaisen sijaisuuden vähintään vuoden 2026 loppuun asti
- Rauhallisen, turvallisen ja nykyaikaisen työympäristön.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ja osaamista kehitysvammaisuudesta sekä valmiuksia kohdata asiakkaiden yksilölliset tarpeet. Hallitset asiakaskirjaamisen, kuntouttavan työotteen, apuvälineiden käytön sekä kommunikaation tukemisen ja ohjaustyön menetelmät. Lisäksi tunnet tarvittavaa lainsäädäntöä ja sinulla on IMO- ja YKS-osaamista.

Työskentelet sujuvasti sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä. Osaat tehdä tilanteen vaatimia ratkaisuja, omaat hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä suhtaudut myönteisesti uuden oppimiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen kehitysvammatyöstä, vaihtoehtoisten kommunikaatiomenetelmien osaamisen sekä suoritetut vammaistyön opinnot.

Tule mukaan tekemään arjesta turvallista, sujuvaa ja merkityksellistä. Odotamme hakemustasi Koskelan asumisyksikköön!
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme sijaisuuden sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Solution Engineer, Wave
description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 40 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer to help marine industry customers get more value from their PLM solutions. In this role, you will configure, customize, and develop Cadmatic Wave to support customer-specific requirements and business processes.

You are based in Finland, Germany, or the Netherlands and can work remotely or in a hybrid model. The role includes regular visits to customer sites across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to work closely with customers and support them in their day-to-day use of Cadmatic solutions.

What you will work on:

- Support technical deployment of Cadmatic Wave in customer environments.
- Develop customer-specific enhancements that extend system capabilities beyond the core product.
- Configure and customize Cadmatic Wave to align with customer workflows and business goals.
- Collaborate with clients and solution consultants to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
- Act as the technical point of contact, ensuring clear communication and trusted partnerships.
- Oversee system rollouts and data migrations, ensuring minimal disruption and data integrity.
- Provide valuable feedback to R&D based on customer insights and project experiences.

We wish you to bring:

- Bachelors or masters degree in IT, engineering, or a related field.
- Solid experience in PLM implementation, consulting, or software configuration.
- Experience in software customization, aligning solutions to client-specific needs.
- Knowledge in requirements engineering, creating requirement specifications and writing user stories.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and database management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail.
- A customer-focused approach and an interest in solving practical business and technical challenges.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites when needed.

We are especially glad if you have:

- Hands-on experience with PLM solutions, CONTACT PLM seen as advantage.
- Know-how of industry business processes related to product/project
- Experience with API integrations, cloud-based PLM solutions, and data migration methodologies.
- Exposure to software deployment, integration methodologies, and custom application development.

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions.
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together.
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally.
- Competitive benefits and flexible working practices that support worklife balance.
- An engineerminded, peoplefirst culture — we take our work seriously but also enjoy ourselves along the way.

Join our growth journey!

Delight us with your application by 13 September. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our hiring manager Ankit Talati via email ankit.talati@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted to our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

We will share the salary range in the interview invitation with candidates who progress to the interview stage.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that success comes from building an inclusive company culture and providing equal opportunities for our People.

title: Data Center Build Manager (rakennuttajapäällikkö)
description:
**Nordecon Oy | Riihimäki, Finland | Permanent position**

We are building a data center in Riihimäki, designed from the ground up for demanding AI and high-performance computing workloads. The project is in full swing, with the first phases targeting production readiness by the end of 2026. Server rooms are built in phases, so there is work here for a long time to come. We are looking for a build manager to drive the project forward as the owner's representative.

This is not a site foreman role. Designers, contractors and equipment suppliers handle the execution. You own the whole: schedule, budget, contracts and the interfaces to the grid company, suppliers and authorities. You report directly to the CEO and get the opportunity to build a team around you as the project and operational phase require.

What you will do

- Own the project schedule, budget and overall delivery as the owner's representative

- Direct and coordinate contractors, designers and equipment suppliers

- Own the electrical infrastructure as a whole: grid company interface, transformer station, backup power and their commissioning

- Manage permit processes and cooperation with authorities (building control, inspections)

- Ensure occupational safety and regulatory compliance on site

- Drive commissioning inspections, acceptance and documented handover to the operating organization

- Report to management and assess resourcing needs for the build and operational phases


What we expect

- A relevant technical degree (e.g. construction, electrical or building services engineering) or equivalent competence gained through experience

- At least 8 years of experience in owner's side project management of industrial or technical facility projects

- Strong understanding of electrical infrastructure: grid connections, transformer stations, backup power, commissioning inspections

- Experience with construction contracts and contract management (YSE 1998)

- A track record of schedule and cost control in projects

- Knowledge of Finnish permit and regulatory processes

- Fluent Finnish is required, as contractors, the grid company and authorities work in Finnish. English is used in technical documentation.


As a person you are self-driven and firm. You take full ownership, keep contractors on schedule and see things through to the finish.

What we consider a plus

- A strong plus: experience with data center projects or environments, including redundancy, power distribution, cooling and availability requirements

- Experience with Tier-classified data centers or the Uptime Institute framework

- Familiarity with SFS 6001

- Fluency with scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project)

- Experience with facility maintenance after commissioning


What we offer

- Ownership of the entire project and a direct reporting line to the CEO.

- The opportunity to build a team around you: you assess and propose the hiring needs for the build and operational phases.

- We are primarily hiring for a permanent position, but we are open to a fixed-term contract as well. Since the rooms are built in phases and the operational phase follows, there is work in sight far into the future.


The work is done mainly on site in Riihimäki, but remote work is acceptable whenever it is possible.

title: Försäljingsförhandlare
description:
Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är ett inhemskt vitamin försäljningshus. Vi säljer hälsoprodukter som möjliggör en hälsosammare och bättre livsstil. Vi rekryterar nu nya heltids arbetare till vårt försäljningsteam.

Vi betalar nya anställda 10 euro i timmen. Du kan tjäna ännu mer enligt vår vanliga ersättningsmodell, men du får minst 10 euro i timmen oavsett försäljningsresultat.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är en del av HL-Family Oy. HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hyvinvointitukku.fi/rekrytointi/.

title: Liikunnanohjaaja
description:
Sipoo on kasvava ja ketterä, kaksikielinen kunta pääkaupunkiseudun läheisyydessä. Sipoon kunnan arki- ja vapaa-ajan toimialan liikuntapalvelujen tehtävänä on ylläpitää ja kehittää kunnan liikuntapaikkoja ja virkistysalueita tarkoituksenmukaisen, monipuolisen ja turvallisen liikuntaharrastuksen ja vapaa-ajanvieton mahdollistamiseksi sekä innostaa kuntalaisia liikkumaan järjestämällä houkuttelevia ja matalan kynnyksen liikunnanohjauspalveluita.

Haluatko tehdä monipuolista ja merkityksellistä työtä liikunnanohjauksen parissa?

Haemme nyt Sipoon kunnan arjen ja vapaa-ajan toimialalle liikuntapalveluihin

LIIKUNNANOHJAAJAA vakinaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.10.2026 alkaen tai aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikunnanohjaajana päätehtäviisi kuuluvat:

- liikunnanohjaus kaikille ikäryhmille
- liikuntaneuvonta
- liikuntaryhmien ohjaaminen (vesiliikunta-, erityisliikunta- ja senioriryhmät)
- varhaiskasvatuksen ja koulujen liikuntaan aktivointi
- leiritoiminnan toteutus koulujen loma-aikoina
- tapahtumien suunnittelu ja toteutus
- molemmilla kotimaisilla kielillä viestintä, (asiakasviestintä sekä verkkosivujen päivitys ja some-viestintä)

Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liikuntakoordinaattorin kanssa. Teet yhteistyötä myös monialaisesti kunnan eri toimialojen, Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen ja kolmannen sektorin vapaa-ajantoiminnan järjestäjien kanssa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on soveltuva alempi korkeakoulututkinto tai liikunnanohjauksen perustutkinto tai vastaava liikunta-alan koulutus.
Tehtävien menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää kokemusta liikunnan ohjaamisesta eri kohderyhmille. Lisäksi edellytämme toisen kotimaisen kielen hyvää kirjallista ja suullista osaamista sekä toisen kotimaisen kielen vähintään tyydyttävää kirjallista ja suullista osaamista.

Hakijalta odotamme lisäksi asiakaslähtöistä, aikaansaavaa ja oma-aloitteista asennetta sekä innostavaa otetta matalan kynnyksen liikuntaan. Arvostamme kehittävää ja positiivista työasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja IT-taitoja sekä organisointikykyä.
Eduksi luetaan kokemus liikuntaneuvonnasta, erityisliikunta- ja senioriliikuntaryhmien ohjauskokemus sekä pätevyys uimakoulujen ohjaamiseen, hyvät verkostotyöskentelytaidot sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuus.

Palkkaus ja työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen KVTESin mukaisesti, tehtäväkohtainen tasopalkka on 2676,40e/kk. Työ sisältää säännöllisesti 1-2 kertaa viikossa iltatyötä ja satunnaisesti viikonlopputöitä.Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk:n koeaikaa. Valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle kaksikielisen kunnan nykyaikaisen ja eteenpäin pyrkivän, reilun työyhteisön, monipuolisia työtehtäviä ja mielenkiintoista yhteistyötä myös kolmannen sektorin vapaa-ajantoiminnan järjestäjien kanssa.

Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si ohessa olevan linkin kautta 10.9.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä tai kotisivuillamme www.sipoo.fi/rekry. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

title: Contract Manager @ Davie Shipyards in Finland
description:
**Calling all experienced contract managers who are ready for their next challenge!**

Are you a customer-centric and commercially minded contract management professional? Do you have exposure to working with complex and high-value projects? Are you motivated by taking ownership in a growth-seeking business environment?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Davie Shipyards in Finland** as their very first **Contract Manager**!

This newly established role will be part of the Legal team and offers a unique opportunity to help shape contract management practices and work at the interface between Projects, Procurement, Legal and Business teams. Due to a strong order book and the strategic decision to pursue growth, the operations of Davie Shipyards in Finland are expanding rapidly, making this a particularly exciting time to join the team!

_Davie Shipyards in Finland brings together Helsinki Shipyard in Helsinki and SATA Shipbuilding in Pori, combining internationally recognised Finnish shipbuilding expertise with some of the world's most demanding maritime projects. Davie, a privately held international marine group with operations in Canada, Finland, and the United States_, _is one of the world's leading builders of icebreakers, specialised vessels and offshore structures. As part of Davie, Davie Shipyards in Finland works on complex projects in Finland and internationally. You can learn more about Davie Shipyards in Finland athttps://helsinkishipyard.fi/company/helsinki-shipyard-oy/._

**In this role,** you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex international shipbuilding projects in direct customer-interface. In more practical terms, you will:

- Identify and manage contractual and commercial risks

- Serve as the first point of contact towards customers, ensuring that that they remain updated on the progress of the project

- Support in contract interpretation and implementation

- Manage change orders, contractual notices and claims processes

- Participate in contract negotiations and commercial discussions

- Ensure compliance with contractual obligations during project execution

- Develop contract management processes, templates and best practices

- Promote contractual awareness across the organisation


The legal team of Davie Shipyards in Finland works primarily from the Helsinki Shipyard office in southern Helsinki. While the team works flexibly, we are looking for someone who enjoys working mainly on-site and being an active part of the team's day-to-day collaboration. The role requires occasional travel.

You will join a growing team of a handful of legal professionals, and report to the Head of Legal of Davie Shipyards in Finland. You will also have a dotted reporting line to the Head of Sales and get support from your international contract management colleagues based in other Davie office locations.

**This role would be ideal for a contract management professional who:**

- has a relevant degree e.g. in Business, Engineering or Law, combined with 5+ years of experience in contract management, commercial management or project environments;

- has experience in working with complex commercial contracts and a strong understanding of contractual risk management, as well as experience in working with and supporting project organisations;

- works with a practical and commercially minded, customer-centric approach;

- is capable of building processes and best practices, and knows how to raise awareness and influence others across the organization; and

- has great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish.


Experience in shipbuilding, industrial, construction, infrastructure or EPC projects is considered an advantage.

**Davie Shipyards in Finland offers you:**

- **Independent responsibility:** As the first Contract Manager to join Davie Shipyards in Finland, you will have an independent and integral role in supporting in large-scale, technically complex international projects.

- **Building a Contract Management Function in Finland:** You get to shape the way Davie Shipyards in Finland operates in terms contract management in Finland.

- **Frontline role:** You will have a frontline role working with clients, as well as in close co-operation internally with business, legal, procurement and project teams.

- **International & growth-seeking working environment**: You will be part of world-leading icebreaker and special vessel projects around the world, working with international customers and contractors and alongside colleagues across the Davie organisation in an actively growth-seeking corporate setting.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **3 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruitment consultant Vilma Suomi (+358 50 360 5134 or vilma.suomi@minjon.fi).

_In line with the hiring policies ofDavie Shipyards in Finland, a security clearance based on the Security Clearance Act (726/2014) as well as drug testing will be performed on the selected candidate._

title: Onsite Network Specialist
description:
Are you a proactive network professional who enjoys hands-on work and supporting reliable IT services in an onsite environment? We are looking for 3 people to become Onsite Network Specialists to ensure stable and efficient local network services at our site(s).

In this role, you will be responsible for the local network environment within your support area. You will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external service partners to maintain reliable network operations, support continuous improvement, and ensure that local business needs are met.

The purpose of the Onsite Network Specialist role is to deliver reliable service for the local network environment at the site(s) in the assigned country. The role works towards operational efficiency, supports continuous improvement of services, and cooperates closely with business counterparts as well as internal and external service partners.

Key responsibilities

Ensure that safety rules and regulations are followed in all daily activities.

Take responsibility for the Local Area Network, LAN, within the assigned support area.

Install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain manageable network infrastructure.

Support fault correction and preventive actions to improve network reliability.

Assist with the design of local network solutions and requirements.

Coordinate and implement local network changes.

Maintain operational documentation, configuration records, and CMDB data to ensure accuracy.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field

2–5 years of experience in key network technologies.

Good knowledge of LAN, WLAN, firewalls, and DHCP.

Experience in network installation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

Good communication skills in English and Finnish, both spoken and written.

Proactive working style with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage own time and workload.

Ability to work independently as well as in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders.

Requirement to be onsite for the majority of the time.

Safety-focused mindset and willingness to follow local safety rules and regulations.

Drivers license

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter in English till the 20th of September 2026. The position might be filled before the final application date, thus, please do not hesitate to apply earlier!

The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment
