General Counsel YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg

JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Employer: YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg.

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international
travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support
• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.
2. Corporate, M&A and governance
• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.
3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation
• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.
4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance
• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.
5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions
• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures. 6. Commercial and employment
• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):
• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.

description:

Job ID: 10486914 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Have you ever ordered a product on the Amazon website and wondered how it got delivered to you via Same Day, and what kinds of topology, demand and capacity processes are running behind the scenes to power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for steering our LTP topology to deliver end-to-end benefits across Customer Experience, Speed, and Cost. This is a role for an exceptionally talented person, with high energy and courage, passionate about ambiguity and delivering concrete improvements for our customers, and who wants to achieve that using data. The role is split 70% analytics and 30% project management.
The key job responsibilities can be split in two buckets:

(1) Data Analytics/Science

- Deep dive complex data to uncover actionable insights for known and unknown problems
- Good expertise with SQL techniques
- Build strong analytics tools to highlight defects and extract actionable insights from our end-to-end supply chain

(2) Project management:

- Lead regular business reviews with partner teams to monitor progress of projects in the roadmap, and help remove bottlenecks
- Use and share your insights with partner teams to influence and build a roadmap of projects that accelerate speed of deliveries in your country
- For the most complex and ambitious opportunities, quickly launch new pilots and build scale-up business cases with benefits, bottlenecks, risks, and resources required
- Consolidate progress into crisp, concise, data-driven status updates. You will own reporting to Amazon senior leadership.

A day in the life

You'll work across First Mile and Last Mile topology teams to shape the physical network that powers Same Day: classifying and sizing node types (Nexus, dedicated Same Day sites, standard fulfillment sites), evaluating RE candidates against coverage and capacity needs, and reconciling demand against what the network can realistically serve at a regional and site level. You'll turn that analysis into a prioritized roadmap and drive it through recurring workshops with Real Estate, Topology, Finance, and Science partners, tracking action items to closure and reporting progress up to senior leadership.

About the team

Long Term Planning Analytics Team

- Same Day Topology LTP is one of those analytical teams. We are obsessed by rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our products can be delivered the same-day.

Between now and 2029 the network expands to over 200 dedicated fulfillment nodes to reach 60%+ Prime demand coverage. Delivering that requires solving hard problems across product selection, inventory buying and placement, inbound network design, and promise and fulfillment logic.

description:
Program Manager, ICON Global Logistics Operations, ICON Global Logistics Operations
Job ID: 10474586 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon Global Logistics is a team of logistics professionals, carrier specialists, and program managers focused on improving the speed, reliability, and cost of Amazon's cross-border supply chain. The team executes the movement of freight from global manufacturing hubs into Amazon's international marketplaces - serving Retail, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) sellers, and new transportation products. Beyond operating today's network, the team builds new logistics capabilities, drives cost-to-serve reduction, and deploys AI and automation to transform how cross-border freight moves at scale.

We are hiring a Program Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of ocean freight across Retail, FBA, and new transportation lanes - from roadmap definition through execution. You will build and manage a portfolio of initiatives spanning cost optimization, network expansion, and new product launches. You will drive planning across Product, Ocean, Customs, and Destination Ops teams to meet SLA and cost-per-unit targets - and regularly lead business reviews with senior leaders to align priorities and unblock execution. The role operates at the intersection of strategy and operations: defining how we scale reliable, cost-efficient ocean logistics while managing carrier relationships, cross-team dependencies, and network constraints in real time.

You will need a strong analytical background, the ability to make data-driven decisions across multiple programs, and the discipline to lead through influence rather than authority. You should be comfortable thinking strategically about supply chain initiatives - including identifying opportunities for AI-driven process improvement and automation - while executing at the operational level. You should be able to build consensus with senior leaders on objectives and trade-offs.

This role requires up to 15% travel to Amazon network facilities and on-site visits with carriers and logistics service providers.

Key job responsibilities

• Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives spanning cost-to-serve optimization, network expansion, and new product launches - from roadmap through execution.
• Drive cost reduction through LSP efficiency improvements, mode optimization (benchmarking lead time, cost, and emissions), and operational charge elimination.
• Partner with Product and Tech teams to evaluate, develop, and launch new transportation programs that improve seller experience and reduce cost-to-serve.
• Identify and deploy AI and automation opportunities to transform operational processes - from forecasting and capacity planning to carrier management and reporting.
• Design and maintain capacity risk frameworks across operating units and sites - defining triggers, escalation paths, and forecast accuracy standards.
• Coordinate across internal functions (Controllership, Finance, Operations Center, Global Trade Services) to ensure aligned execution with carriers and customers.
• Lead business and planning reviews with senior leaders to align priorities, surface trade-offs, and unblock execution.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.
• Experience in global and multi-regulatory environments.
• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:

    Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
    Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
    Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
    Free Gym Membership
    Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
    Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:

    Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
    Service-minded with good communications skills
    A fast-learner
    A flexible team player
    Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
    An entertainer at heart
    Excellent customer service skills
    Manage Player expectations and behavior
    Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.

Send your CV to viktorrecruit@gmail.com

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

description:
Are you passionate about gaming, customer service, and cutting-edge VR technology? We are looking for an energetic and reliable Arcade & VR Gaming Centre Operator to join our team! In this role, you will be the face of our gaming centre welcoming guests, ensuring a seamless gaming experience, and keeping our facility running smoothly.

Be at the Center of Entertainment: You get to work in a vibrant, fast-paced environment where creating fun and memorable experiences for guests is the daily goal.

Als helpdeskmedewerker digitale dienstverlening werk je binnen het Klantcontactcentrum (KCC) en ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers van MijnNVWA. Ondernemers en burgers nemen contact met je op wanneer zij vragen hebben over het online portaal of vastlopen tijdens een digitale aanvraag. Jij luistert, onderzoekt het probleem en helpt hen snel weer op weg.


Je krijgt te maken met uiteenlopende technische en inhoudelijke vragen. Zo help je gebruikers bij het invullen van formulieren, onderzoek je foutmeldingen en kijk je waarom een aanvraag of registratie niet zichtbaar is. Hiervoor maak je gebruik van verschillende systemen en informatiebronnen. Kun je een probleem niet zelf oplossen? Dan schakel je met een specialistische afdeling en zorg je voor een goede opvolging. Is het rustiger binnen MijnNVWA? Dan ondersteun je collega's binnen het Klantcontactcentrum bij andere vragen en meldingen.


Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:


• Beantwoorden van telefonische en digitale vragen over MijnNVWA.
• Begeleiden van gebruikers bij online formulieren en digitale aanvragen.
• Onderzoeken van foutmeldingen, storingen en andere technische vraagstukken.
• Vaststellen of een probleem zelf opgelost kan worden of moet worden doorgezet naar een specialistische afdeling.
• Signaleren van terugkerende problemen en hierover afstemmen met collega's.
• Samenwerken met verschillende interne afdelingen om gebruikers optimaal te ondersteunen.
• Werken met meerdere systemen en informatiebronnen om de juiste oplossing te vinden.
• Ondersteunen van collega's binnen het Klantcontactcentrum wanneer dat nodig is.



Je werkt 32 tot 36 uur per week tijdens kantooruren van 08.30 tot 17.00 uur. Tijdens je inwerkperiode werk je volledig op kantoor. Zodra je goed bent ingewerkt, werk je ongeveer 50% op kantoor en 50% vanuit huis. De opdracht duurt 6 maanden, met kans op verlenging.

title: Assistent Filiaalleider Kringloopwinkel - Leerdam
description:
Wij hebben de baan die jij zoekt!

Leuk werk, een fijn team en werk dat ertoe doet. Klinkt goed? Dan is de functie van assistent filiaalleider voor ons filiaal in Leerdam misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

In deze rol ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor je collegas en vorm je samen met de andere assistent filiaalleiders de verbindende schakel tussen het team en de filiaalleider. Organiseren en plannen gaan je van nature goed af. Of het nu gaat om de dagelijkse aansturing of om die comfortabele bank die precies op tijd bij de klant moet worden afgeleverd: jij houdt het overzicht en zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt.

Als assistent filiaalleider maak je écht verschil. Je draagt bij aan een duurzamere wereld én aan de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers uit diverse doelgroepen. Je weet mensen te motiveren en te begeleiden, zonder het organisatiebelang uit het oog te verliezen. Snel schakelen gaat je gemakkelijk af en je ziet kansen waar anderen obstakels zien. Daarbij is er volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, initiatief en aanpak.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gewoon jezelf. Enthousiast, geduldig en communicatief sterk.

Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Stuur dan snel jouw c.v. en motivatie. Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

description:
Jouw werkplek

Op jouw nieuwe werkplek wonen cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking (EVMB+), soms met bijkomende gedragsproblematiek. Samen met jouw team bied je hen een veilige, betrouwbare omgeving waarin zij zich op hun eigen manier kunnen ontwikkelen. Op je werkplek word je ondersteund door een zorgcoördinator en gedragsdeskundige, die je helpen bij het begeleiden van cliënten met moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag.

Elke dag zorg je voor een zinvolle invulling, thuis of bij dagbesteding dichtbij. Met een persoonlijk en groepsgericht dagprogramma bied je structuur en veiligheid, zodat bewoners zich écht thuis voelen. Of het nu gaat om een wandeling, een activiteit in de woonkamer of samen rustig zitten – jullie doen het samen, in een omgeving vol vertrouwen.

Jouw rol en aanpak Je werkt volgens de Triple C-visie, waarbij onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding en het samen ondernemen van betekenisvolle activiteiten centraal staan. Met een luisterend oor en oog voor non-verbale signalen stem jij af op de behoefte van de cliënten. Je bent alert op subtiele veranderingen, zodat je op tijd kunt inspelen op wat iemand fysiek of emotioneel nodig heeft.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ondersteuning bieden bij persoonlijke verzorging en indien nodig verpleegkundige handelingen.
  • Begeleiden bij dagelijkse activiteiten, zoals zwemmen, wandelen en fietsen afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van de cliënt.
  • Je moet kunnen observeren, rapporteren en helder kunnen communiceren.
  • Je werkt vanuit verbinding samen met collega’s en het sociale netwerk van de cliënten.

Wat heb je nodig?

  • Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met de zorg voor cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
  • Je bent geduldig, empathisch en kunt goed afstemmen op de behoeften van de cliënt
  • Je werkt onvoorwaardelijk en kunt voorbij probleemgedrag kijken om tot de kern te komen

title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

PhD Community
The PhD Community at the Rudolf Agricola School is a vibrant network of 60 early-career researchers tackling the complex challenges of sustainable development from an inter- and transdisciplinary perspective. It provides a supportive space for collaboration and knowledge exchange.
What do you offer?
As a member, you will have access to a variety of activities designed to enrich your research journey. These include hands-on workshops on interdisciplinary methods, opportunities to apply to grant proposals, and informal networking events (including drinks!)) where you can exchange ideas with peers and meet other researchers working on similar topics. Last year, we organized two training workshops, on interdisciplinarity and societal impact , as well as several informal gatherings.
Who can join?
Our community welcomes any PhD candidates whose research relates to sustainable development. We particularly encourage those working at the intersection of disciplines or in collaboration with societal partners to be part of our network.
How to join?
To join our PhD community you must simply become a Fellow and you will automatically be part of our PhD Community.
Whether you want to broaden your academic horizons, collaborate across disciplines, or simply connect with others navigating the (inter- and transdisciplinary) PhD experience, the PhD Community at the Rudolf Agricola School is the perfect place to start!

title: Klar til å forme fremtidens løsninger for maritim sikkerhet?
description:
Hvert år seiler flere tusen fartøy verden over med sikkerhetsutstyr fra Martin Bruusgaard om bord. I over 60 år har vi bygget oss en posisjon som et av de ledende selskapene innen deteksjonsløsninger for maritim bransje, og i dag er vår løsning for bærbar gassdeteksjon installert på over 3 000 fartøy verden over.

Vi er kjent for The Bruusgaard System (TBS), som overvåker status på kundenes fartøy, sørger for at riktig instrumentering er om bord, og bidrar til at kalibrering og vedlikehold gjennomføres i tråd med gjeldende krav og regelverk. I tillegg leverer vi andre løsninger, utviklet slik at mannskapet i størst mulig grad selv skal kunne utføre vedlikehold om bord. Det reduserer kostnader, øker sikkerheten og forenkler logistikken for kundene våre.

Nå er vi inne i en positiv utvikling, og skal styrke det tekniske teamet vårt videre inn i neste vekstfase. Vi utvider tilbudet vårt fra bærbar til også å omfatte faste gassdeteksjonssystemer, og satser samtidig videre på digitalisering – med kundeportalen myBruusgaard som en sentral del av samhandlingen med kundene, og kunstig intelligens som et arbeidsverktøy vi forventer skal bli stadig viktigere i årene fremover.

Som en del av det tekniske teamet vårt får du varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver i et miljø med høyt tempo og stor aktivitet. Du jobber på tvers av organisasjonen, bygger bred forståelse for produktene, kundene og driften vår, og er med på å forme veien videre i en bedrift i vekst.

Litt om arbeidsoppgaver

Som en del av vårt tekniske team vil du få varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver i et miljø med høyt tempo og stor aktivitet. Du vil jobbe på tvers av organisasjonen og utvikle en bred forståelse av våre produkter, løsninger, kunder og operasjoner. En vanlig arbeidshverdag vil bestå av:

  • Teknisk support til kunder, og kollegaer
  • Feilsøking, teknisk problemløsning og enkel service på vårt serviceverksted ved kontoret i Sandvika
  • Tilpasse og videreutvikle teknisk dokumentasjon
  • Bidra til videreutvikling av myBruusgaard og andre digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • Bruke AI-verktøy aktivt og hensiktsmessig i det daglige arbeidet
  • Delta i tekniske prosjekter og utviklingsarbeid
Våre tanker om din utdannelse og erfaring

Vi tror denne stillingen passer deg med teknisk bakgrunn og god kommersiell forståelse, en nyutdannet ingeniør eller en kandidat med relevant praktisk erfaring. Du bør trives med kundekontakt, ha god teknisk og digital forståelse og være interessert i å sette deg inn i nye produkter og løsninger.

Relevant erfaring kan være fra kundeservice, teknisk support, feilsøking, faste deteksjonssystemer eller andre tekniske og datarelaterte løsninger. Erfaring fra maritim industri eller olje- og gassindustrien vil være en fordel.

title: Vi søkjer engasjert ergoterapeut som vil bidra til utvikling
description:
Vi har ledig 100 % stilling med arbeid i turnus for ein engasjert ergoterapeut som vil bidra til utvikling av tenestene ved Luranetunet bu- og behandlingsenter avd. Fjordheim.  

Er dette deg? 
Luranetunet bu- og behandlingssenter ser på ulike måtar å organisere arbeidet på for å sikre kvalitet i tenestene og ha rett kompetanse på rett plass. Vi treng deg som ønsker å være med å vidareutvikle denne måten å jobbe på og ser moglegheiter framfor begrensinger. 

Som ergoterapeut i avdelinga vil du få eit særskilt og sjølvstendig ansvar for: 

  • Kartlegge behov, bestille/søke om og tilpasse hjelpemiddel 
  • Rettleie og vere ein ressursperson i høve til ergonomi 
  • Fungere som forflytningskontakt på Fjordheim og bidra med kompetanse inn i nettverket for forflytningskontakter 
  • Bidra med kompetanse ut over eiga avdeling, samt mynde til å instruere anna personell i situasjoner der ein ønsker ei vurdering av ergoterapeut. 

    Du vil være ein av grunnbemanninga og fellesskapet på avdeling Fjordheim

Avdeling Fjordheim er ei avdeling med 20 bebuarar som har diagnosen demens. Dei bur i eigne omsorgsbustadar i 1. etg på Luranetunet med utgang til Sansehagen (ute) og Tropehagen. 

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • har autorisasjon som ergoterapeut
  • har eit hjarte som bankar ekstra for eldreomsorg 
  • ser kva for oppgåver som er viktige i arbeidet med å aktivisera og stimulera bebuarane for å få fram glede og trivsel i kvardagen 
  • deler kompetansen din og har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner. 
  • er bevisst handlingane dine og set respekt, lojalitet og etikk høgt. 
  • bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet i avdelinga, og er villig til å bidra på andre avdelingar med kompetansen din når det trengst.  

Det vil bli lagt vekt på dine personlege eigenskapar 
Søkjarar må ha gode norske språkferdigheitar, både munnleg og skriftleg 

Arbeidsstad 

Kun nokre minuttars køyring frå Bergen ligg Luranetunet Bu- og behandlingssenter. Senteret rommar 2 korttidsavdelingar og 7 langtidsavdelingar. Dei to korttidsavdelingane er rehabiliteringsavdeling og behandlingsavdeling med til saman 40 plassar. Her kjem det inn pasientar inn både frå heimen og sjukehuset for behandling og rehabilitering. På langtidsavdelingane har vi 2 buavdelingar, og 5 avdelingar tilpassa personar med demens sjukdom. Bebuarane våre er i ulike fasar av sjukdomen sin. Nokre er i god fysisk form, medan andre er i livets sluttfase. Vi ønskjer å bli kjent med personen bak sjukdommen, og har fokus på kommunikasjon og miljøarbeid. Saman med bebuaren, pårørande og andre helsetenester jobbar vi for å finne dei beste løysingane for kvar enkelt. 

Luranetunet sin visjon er «Varme og vekst i samspel». Visjonen spring ut av den flotte, overbygde tropehagen på 1300 m2 i sentrum av Luranetunet. Her er det varmt og godt heile året, og aktivitet på både dag- og kveldstid. 
Hagen er ein god plass å vere for bebuarar, pårørande og tilsette - og alt anna som veks og trivst når vi legg til rette for det. Ute har vi sansehage med lysthus, bærbuskar, tre og planter. 
Varme og vekst står for den gode omsorga bebuarane våre skal oppleve, den personlege og fagleg utviklinga vi ønskjer for dei tilsette, og den varme velkomsten vi vil gi til pårørande og andre som kjem på besøk til oss. 
Luranetunet er ein utdanningsinstitusjon med mange studentar, lærlingar og elevar i praksis og vi har eigne sjukeheimslegar i faste store stillingar. 
Som helsepersonell må du vera førebudd på å arbeide utover eiga avdeling og bruka kompetansen din der behovet til ei kvar tid er størst. 

Vil du lesa meir om Luranetunet bu- og behandlingssenter sjå vår heimeside: 
Luranetunet bu- og behandlingssenter - Bjørnafjorden kommune (bjornafjorden.kommune.no) 

Vi gjer merksam på at du må legge fram politiattest. 

Vi kan tilby:

  • 100 % stilling med arbeid kvar 3. helg i eit aktivt miljø, med høgt tempo, fokus på fag og gode kollegaer 
  • Vi har fokus på heiltidskultur og fleksible arbeidstidsordningar 
  • Som ny i avdelinga vil du få god oppfølging og rettleiing 
  • Luranetunet satsar på kompetansebygging og det er moglegheit for relevant vidareutdanning
  • God pensjonsordning, yrkesskade- og gruppelivsforsikring 
  • Løn etter gjeldande avtalar 

Bjørnafjorden kommune er ein arbeidsplass som verdset likestilling og mangfald, der alle tilsette forpliktar seg til prinsippet om likeverd og bidreg til å skapa eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø.Vi ønskjer eit mangfald av søkjarar og oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, etnisk bakgrunn eller livssyn.

Etter utløpt søknadsfrist, vil det bli generert ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar kan bli offentlege sjølv om ein har kryssa av for å bli unnateke. Dersom anmodningen ikkje vert tatt til følgje vil søkjaren bli varsla om det. 

Vi vil aldri be søkjar om å oppgi BANK-ID informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

Bjørnafjorden kommune har i overkant av 26 000 innbyggarar og rundt 1800 kommunalt tilsette. Vi er ein nær og varm kommune, noko som gjenspeglar seg i misjonen vår “Det gode liv for alle”. Som arbeidstakar bidrar du med oppgåver som er viktig for innbyggarane våre og lokalsamfunnet vårt. Du betyr noko, og det du gjer betyr noko! Vi jobbar med fleire spennande prosjekt, og er alltid på utkikk etter engasjerte folk med hjartet på rette staden. Er det deg?

title: PhD fellowship: Improve Aortic Valve Disease Assessment Using Experimental and Computational Models
description:
A 3-year PhD-fellowship is available at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital. This is one out of two fellowships at The Intervention Centre that is part of the Cardiovascular Digital Twin network comprising a total of 15 fellowships across Europe (https://www.cdtnet.eu/). The project is funded by the European Research Council’s MSCA program.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!
Arbeidsoppgaver

Project and Job Description

Transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) has transformed the treatment of aortic valve disease, allowing many patients to receive life-changing therapy without open-heart surgery. However, the growing use of TAVI has also increased the need for accurate methods to assess valve disease, identify patients who will benefit from intervention, determine the optimal timing of treatment, and evaluate outcomes after the procedure. Current echocardiographic measures of valve severity and haemodynamic performance rely on simplified assumptions about valve geometry and blood flow that may not fully reflect the complex flow conditions present in individual patients.

This project aims to improve the assessment of aortic valve disease through the development of patient-specific experimental and computational models. The doctoral candidate will develop three-dimensional printed models of diseased aortic valves and play a central role in the further development and validation of a laboratory-based mock circulation platform capable of reproducing physiological pulsatile flow conditions. This experimental framework will enable the acquisition of high-fidelity pressure and flow measurements that can be directly compared with echocardiographic assessments.

A central objective of the project is to investigate the accuracy and limitations of current echocardiographic methods for estimating transvalvular pressure gradients and valve severity. By combining controlled experimental studies with patient-specific valve geometries, the project will identify haemodynamic and anatomical conditions under which commonly used echocardiographic assumptions break down and explore how these limitations can be overcome. Emerging ultrasound techniques such as blood speckle tracking (BST) will also be evaluated to determine whether they provide additional haemodynamic information beyond conventional Doppler methods.

To provide mechanistic insight into the experimental findings, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) models, including fluid–structure interaction (FSI) simulations where appropriate, will be developed and validated against experimental measurements. These models will be used to investigate the relationships between valve morphology, flow patterns, pressure recovery, and pressure loss, helping to explain the limitations of simplified Bernoulli-based approaches. The computational framework will also serve as a theoretical framework for the development of improved echocardiographic methods based on clinically obtainable measurements, which will subsequently be evaluated and validated against reference measurements obtained in the mock circulation system.

The candidate will benefit from access to one of Europe's largest TAVI programmes, extensive clinical and experimental datasets, and international secondments with research groups in London and Ghent that have extensive experience in cardiovascular mock circulation systems and experimental haemodynamics. These collaborations will support the development of the experimental platform and provide opportunities for advanced training and knowledge exchange.

The project will be conducted in close collaboration with cardiologists and clinical researchers involved in the assessment and treatment of patients with aortic valve disease. While echocardiographic examinations will be performed by collaborating clinical investigators, the doctoral candidate will play a central role in integrating experimental, computational, and clinical perspectives to improve diagnostic methods and support more informed treatment decisions. Ultimately, the project aims to improve the evaluation of aortic valve disease and TAVI outcomes by developing diagnostic methods that more closely reflect the underlying haemodynamics, enabling more accurate treatment decisions and more personalized patient care.

Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Desirable Project-Specific Qualifications and Skills

  • We seek a motivated, creative, and enthusiastic candidate with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of engineering, mathematics, and medicine.
  • Applicants should hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Technology, Engineering Cybernetics, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Informatics, or a related discipline.
  • A strong academic record is required, corresponding to a weighted average grade of B or higher.
  • Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations is highly desirable. Experience with fluid–structure interaction (FSI) modelling is an additional advantage.
  • Experience with scientific programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar languages) is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of fluid mechanics, computational mechanics, mathematical modelling, numerical methods, or medical image analysis is considered an advantage.
  • Experience with experimental fluid mechanics, laboratory instrumentation, physical modelling, sensor technology, or experimental validation is advantageous.
  • Experience with three-dimensional modelling, computer-aided design (CAD), or additive manufacturing (3D printing) is beneficial.
  • Previous research experience, including scientific publications, conference presentations, or participation in research projects, is advantageous.
  • Interest in cardiovascular physiology, echocardiography, heart valve disease, medical technology, or computational medicine is desirable.
  • Experience with experimental, pre-clinical, or clinical research, including data collection, validation studies, or analysis of biomedical data, is an advantage.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
  • The successful candidate should be able to work independently while also contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary and international research team.

 

Important Eligibility Rule (MSCA Mobility Requirement)

This position is funded by the European Research Council's MSCA program. To foster international collaboration and knowledge exchange, the program enforces a strict mobility requirement:

Who CANNOT apply: Applicants who have lived, worked, or studied in Norway for more than 12 months in total during the last 3 years.
Who CAN apply: Applicants who have spent less than 12 months in Norway during the last 3 years (including those who have never been to Norway).

We offer:

  • Standard Norwegian PhD fellowship salary according to agreement with labour union
  • Professional development in a friendly and stimulating multi-disciplinary and international working environment
  • Attractive welfare arrangements

The PhD-fellow will be based at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital where the work will be conducted in an interdisciplinary team of research scientists, surgeons, engineers, and university researchers. The employment period is three years (commencing approximately December 2026), including the objective of taking organized academic training (university courses) and the completion of the PhD degree. Admission to a doctoral degree program is a requirement; including undertaking a total of 30 credits coursework from University in Oslo’s (UiO) PhD courses. For regulations concerning the PhD degree at UiO, see: https://www.uio.no/english/research/phd/

Planned Research stays

  • King's College London, United Kingdom (2 months): training in cardiovascular flow phantoms, computational fluid dynamics and advanced haemodynamic measurements.
  • Ghent University, Belgium (1 month): training in cardiovascular flow phantoms, computational fluid dynamics and experimental flow modelling.
  • FEops, Belgium (1 month): exposure to the commercial application of computational modelling for planning structural heart interventions.

 

Application documents:

  • Short statement on the applicant’s personal qualifications and motivation for the position
  • Applicant's CV (including list of publications and relevant former positions)
  • Academic transcripts and degree certificates, with official translation in English
  • Short statement from a former supervisor/tutor/teacher

title: PhD fellowship - Computational Models for Improved Assessment of Diastolic Function
description:
A 3-year PhD-fellowship is available at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital. This is one out of two fellowships at The Intervention Centre that is part of the Cardiovascular Digital Twin network comprising a total of 15 fellowships across Europe (https://www.cdtnet.eu/). The project is funded by the European Research Council’s MSCA program.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Project and Job Description


Heart failure affects millions of people worldwide, and around half of all cases are linked to problems with the heart's ability to relax and fill properly during diastole. Although echocardiography is the most commonly used imaging technique for assessing cardiac function, many of the key factors responsible for diastolic dysfunction—such as myocardial stiffness, impaired relaxation, and elevated filling pressures—cannot be measured directly using current non-invasive methods.


This project aims to improve the assessment of diastolic function by combining echocardiographic measurements with patient-specific digital twin technology. The doctoral candidate will develop mathematical models that link clinically acquired echocardiographic data to the underlying physiological and mechanical properties of the heart. By integrating imaging information with computational models, the project seeks to estimate clinically important parameters that are otherwise difficult to measure without invasive procedures.


While the main focus of the project is the integration of conventional echocardiographic measurements with computational models of cardiac function, there will also be opportunities to investigate emerging ultrasound modalities such as blood speckle tracking (BST). BST provides information about intracardiac flow dynamics and can be used to derive parameters such as intraventricular pressure gradients, energy loss, and flow vortices. The clinical utility of these measurements and their relationship to filling pressures and diastolic function will be explored.


The candidate will participate in the collection and analysis of animal and clinical datasets, including echocardiographic studies with simultaneously recorded invasive pressure measurements. These data will be used to develop, calibrate, and validate the proposed modelling approaches. Ultimately, the project aims to create more accurate and clinically useful tools for diagnosing and monitoring heart failure, supporting earlier intervention and more personalised patient care.

The PhD-fellow will be based at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital where the work will be conducted in an interdisciplinary team of research scientists, surgeons, engineers, and university researchers. The employment period is three years (commencing approximately December 2026), including the objective of taking organized academic training (university courses) and the completion of the PhD degree. Admission to a doctoral degree program is a requirement; including undertaking a total of 30 credits coursework from University in Oslo’s (UiO) PhD courses. For regulations concerning the PhD degree at UiO, see: https://www.uio.no/english/research/phd

Les meir om godane ved å jobbe i staten på Arbeidsgiverportalen (https://arbeidsgiver.dfo.no/lonn-goder-og-reise) 
Vi bruker som hovudregel nynorsk som skriftspråk. Den som vert tilsett må beherske norsk både skriftleg og munnleg. Utviklinga av organisasjonen vår er ein kontinuerleg prosess, og den som vert tilsett må vere open for endringar i organisering, oppgåver og ansvarsområde.
 
Bli betre kjent med Statsforvaltaren i Møre og Romsdal: https://statsforvalteren.no/more-og-romsdal/
Mangfald
Eit godt arbeidsmiljø er prega av mangfald. Vi ønskjer medarbeidarar med ulike kompetansar, fagkombinasjonar, livserfaring og perspektiv for å bidra til ei enda betre oppgåveløysing. Vi oppfordrar difor alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje utan omsyn til alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller etnisk bakgrunn. Du er også velkomen til å søkje sjølv om du ikkje kan vise til ein samanhengande yrkeskarriere. Vi legg til rette for medarbeidarar som har behov for det.

Har du ei funksjonsnedsetting, hol i CV-en eller innvandrarbakgrunn, kan du bli positivt særbehandla om du set kryss for dette når du søkjer stillinga. Du kan lese meir om dette på arbeidsgivarportalen (https://arbeidsgiver.dfo.no/positivsaerbehandling). 
Praktisk informasjon om søknadsprosessen
Alle som søkjer stillinga må søkje digitalt. Når søknadsfristen går ut, vurderer vi søknaden din på bakgrunn av informasjonen du har sendt oss. Det er difor viktig at du både i søknadsbrevet og CV-en, viser korleis kompetansen din fyller krava som er satt i utlysinga.
 
Det er viktig at du registrere all relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring i kandidatprofilen du opprettar i rekrutteringssystemet (sjølv om du legg ved ein ferdigutfylt CV). Dette er nødvendig for at vi skal kunne vurdere søknadar frå deg og for å ivareta kravet om fullstendig søkjarliste.
Relevante vitnemål og attester lastar du opp. Vitnemål og/eller karakterutskrifter henter du frå vitnemålsportalen om mogleg. Har du utdanning frå utlandet, legg du ved godkjenning frå NOKUT/Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse. Vedlegg lastar du opp i PDF-format.
 
Offentleg søkjarliste blir utarbeidd etter søknadsfristens utløp. Om du ønskjer å reservere deg frå den offentlege søkjarlista, må du grunngje dette særskilt. For at vi skal kunne vurdere ønskjet ditt om reservasjon, må du grunngje konkret kva for ulempe det vil ha for deg å stå på den offentlege søkjarlista. Du vil bli varsla om ønsket ditt ikkje vert tatt til følgje. Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlista kan bli offentleg sjølv om du som søkjar ber om anonymitet jf. offentleglova § 25.  
 Om oss
Statsforvaltaren er Kongen og Regjeringa sin fremste representant i fylket. Vi har ansvaret for å informere om statleg politikk og sette handlingsplanar ut i livet. Oppgåvene er i hovudsak rettleiing, tilsyn og klagebehandling retta mot enkeltpersonar, kommunar og bedrifter. Dette gjeld innan kommuneøkonomi og forvaltning, sosial- og familierettslege saker, samfunnstryggleik og beredskap, helse, utdanning, landbruk og miljøvern. Vi er ein kompetansearbeidsplass med om lag 150 medarbeidarar som jobbar for visjonen vår «Trygg framtid for folk og natur».
Har du spørsmål om stillinga? Ta gjerne kontakt med rekrutterande leiar Karin Brigitte Müller Mikaelsen på telefon (Norge +47) 41495351.

title: Vi søker en erfaren mekaniker!
description:
Tilhengerspesialisten AS söker en engagerad och kompetent mekaniker till sitt team i Norge.

Är du en erfaren mekaniker med ett starkt tekniskt intresse och trivs med praktiskt arbete, felsökning och problemlösning? Då kan detta vara en spännande möjlighet för dig.

Om tjänsten

Som mekaniker hos Tilhengerspesialisten AS blir du en viktig del av verksamheten och kommer att arbeta med service, underhåll, reparation och montering av släpvagnar och tillhörande utrustning.

Arbetet är varierande och innebär både självständigt ansvar och nära samarbete med kollegor. Du kommer att arbeta med olika typer av tekniska och mekaniska problem, där noggrannhet och kvalitet står i fokus.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Service, underhåll och reparation av släpvagnar
  • Felsökning och diagnostisering av mekaniska och elektriska problem
  • Arbete med bromssystem, axlar, hjul och chassikomponenter
  • Kontroll och reparation av belysning och fordonsel
  • Montering av utrustning och tillbehör
  • Klargöring och kvalitetskontroll av släpvagnar
  • Löpande underhåll och ordning i verkstaden
  • Övriga förekommande verkstads- och mekanikeruppgifter
Din profil

Vi söker dig som är självständig, noggrann och lösningsorienterad och som har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Relevant utbildning inom mekanik, fordon eller motsvarande
  • Erfarenhet som mekaniker eller tekniker
  • God praktisk och teknisk förståelse
  • Erfarenhet av felsökning och reparation
  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och strukturerat
  • Ett kvalitetsmedvetet och professionellt arbetssätt

Erfarenhet av släpvagnar, trailers, fordonsmekanik eller fordonselektronik är meriterande.

Det viktigaste är att du är praktiskt lagd, ansvarstagande och har en vilja att utvecklas.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Tilhengerspesialisten AS får du möjlighet att bli en del av en specialistverksamhet med fokus på släpvagnar, service och tekniska lösningar.

Vi erbjuder:

  • En varierande och utvecklande tjänst
  • En professionell och kompetent arbetsmiljö
  • Möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper inom mekanik och teknik
  • Varierande och praktiska arbetsuppgifter
  • Konkurrenskraftiga villkor
  • En arbetsplats där kvalitet och kundservice står i fokus
Är du vår nya mekaniker?

Om du känner igen dig i beskrivningen och vill bli en del av Tilhengerspesialisten AS, ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

Skicka in din ansökan och CV redan idag.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Tilhengerspesialisten AS
Specialister på släpvagnar, service och tekniska lösningar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ilhengerspesialisten AS er spesialisert på tilhengere og tilbehør, og tilbyr løsninger til både privatpersoner og bedrifter. Med fokus på kvalitet, service og riktig produkt hjelper vi våre kunder med å finne tilhengeren som best passer deres behov – enten det gjelder fritid, transport, bygg eller profesjonell bruk.

Vi tilbyr et bredt utvalg av tilhengere og tilbehør, samt rådgivning, salg, service og vedlikehold. Vårt mål er å gjøre det enkelt og trygt for våre kunder å velge, kjøpe og bruke riktig tilhenger.

Hos Tilhengerspesialisten AS står kunden alltid i sentrum. Vi kombinerer solid produktkunnskap med personlig service og streber etter å levere kvalitetsprodukter og gode, holdbare løsninger som våre kunder kan være trygge på.

title: Helsefagarbeider på avdeling Juvike
description:
Vil du vere med å utvikle eit sterkt fagmiljø i avdeling Juvike?

Avdeling Juvike er organisert under institusjonstenester på Øystre Slidre helsetun og er ei avdeling for personar med demens. Institusjonstenestene består av 2 langtidsavdelingar, institusjonskjøken samt natt. På avdelinga er det helsefagarbeidarar, sjukepleiarar, vernepleier og assistentar, og vi samarbeider tett med andre avdelingar. Vi jobbar kvar dag for å gje gode tenester til alle brukarane våre.

Vi held til i nye og moderne lokale på Øystre Slidre helsetun. Lokala ligg sentralt til på Heggenes, med flott utsikt over Heggefjorden og mot Jotunheimen. Vi ønskjer å vere ein naturleg del av nærmiljøet, og det er mange aktivitetar på Helsetunet. Velferdsteknologi er eit satsingsområde.


Vi har eit vikariat som helsefagarbeider i 80% som er ledig frå no og eit vikariat i 90% som vil bli ledig frå haust 2026. Oppstart i stillingane kan avtalast nærare. Begge vikariata varer i ca 1 år. 

Vi håper du vil søke og ser fram til å høyre frå deg!


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Gje tenester til brukarar etter enkeltvedtak og etter gjeldande styringsdokument
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgåver som består av å gje helsehjelp og miljøarbeid
  • Dokumentasjon i henhald til gjeldande lover, forskrifter og retningslinjer
  • Samarbeid med andre yrkesgrupper innan helse og omsorg
 Kvalifikasjonar
  • Fagbrev og autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • Det er ønskjeleg med vidareutdanning innan demensomsorg eller med erfaring frå arbeid innan fagfeltet
  • Gode norskkunnskapar
  • Det er krav om politiattest etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §5-4
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Positiv, sjølvstendig og gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Fleksibel, tydeleg og løysningsorientert
  • Engasjert og tek initiativ til forbedringsprosessar 
  • Gode haldninger til brukarar og ser verdien av nytekning innan kvardagsmestring, miljøarbeid og velferdsteknologi
  • Personleg eignaheit vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Engasjerte og fagleg dyktige medarbeidarar
  • 2-delt turnus med kvar 3. helg eller langvakter kvar 4.helg
  • Nødvendig opplæring og rettleiing
  • Kompetanseheving
  • Opplæring i fagsystem
  • Tilrettelegging for vidareutdanning dersom rette søker melder seg i ansettelsesprosessen. Utdannning kan kombinerast med jobb
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsvilkår i KLP

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nasjonalparkkommunen Øystre Slidre ligg ved inngangsporten til Jotunheimen, med Beitostølen som et naturleg utgangspunkt. Vegen er kort til toppturar både sommar og vinter. 

Friluftsliv, jakt, fiske og stølsliv er viktig i kommunen. Du finn mellom anna deler av Langsua nasjonalpark, eit stort turløypenett og milevis med skiløyper i heile kommunen. På Valdresflye varar skisesongen lenge.  Velkommen til rein naturglede!

Reiseliv og jordbruk er blant dei største  næringane, og det finst spanande arbeidsplassar innan fleire bransjar.Øystre Slidre har dei siste åra hatt vekst i folketallet.

Øystre Slidre kommune skal tilby gode tenester til innbyggarar og tilreisande i alle aldersgrupper. Nytt og moderne helsetun stod ferdig i 2021. Eit rikt kulturtilbod, eit godt  tilbod til barn og unge og ein unik dugnadsånd er med på å gjere kommunen til ein attraktivt stad å bu. 

Gode handelstilbod finn ein både i kommunen og rundt regionsenteret Fagernes.

Vil du vite meir om Valdres? Vi har unik natur, kultur og er ein attraktiv region, sentralt i Norge. Les meir på valdres.no.

title: Forsker innen analytisk pesticidkjemi
description:
Om stillingen 

Vi har nå ledig en fast stilling som forsker (1109/1110) i forskningsgruppe marin toksikologi ved HI. Sammensetningen av fiskefôr er i stadig endring, og plantebaserte ingredienser brukes ofte i fôret. Dette kan føre til nye uønskede stoffer som plantevernmidler, PAH-er og mykotoksiner, som tidligere ikke har vært knyttet til fiskefôr. Fôringrediensene hentes fra hele verden, noe som krever brede og omfattende screeningmetoder for å identifisere nye uønskede stoffer.

Vi leter etter en forsker i analytisk pesticidkjemi. Stillingen innebærer vitenskapelig ansvar for NRL-pesticider, og for Havforskningsinstituttets NRL-funksjon, samt rollen som Norges kontaktperson mot EU-RL. Det stilles høye krav til kompetanse innen analytisk kjemi, særlig knyttet til transformasjonsprodukter (TP-er) og screeningsmetoder basert på væskekromatografi med høyoppløselig massespektrometri (LC-HRMS), samt analyser med GC/LC QqQ-MS. Non-target identifisering av TPs krever bruk av KI.  I stillingen skal man også arbeide inn mot instituttets internasjonale nettverk, som EU-RL og EFSA. Stillingen innebærer reiseaktivitet.


Om forskningsgruppen og arbeidet vi gjør

Forskningsgruppe marin toksikologi produserer kunnskap som brukes i beslutninger rundt håndteringen av påvirkning fra forurensninger og uønskede stoffer i marine økosystemer, akvakultur og sjømatproduksjon. Vi bidrar til trygg og bærekraftig bruk av marine ressurser ved å øke forståelsen av hvordan kjemikalier påvirker marine organismer, sjømattrygghet og miljøet.

Vår tverrfaglige forskningsgruppe studerer forekomst, skjebne og biologiske effekter av forurensninger i marine miljøer og hos akvakulturarter. Gruppen kombinerer kompetanse innen bioinformatikk, analytisk kjemi, molekylærbiologi, fiskefysiologi, toksikologi, modellering og risikovurdering.


Kvalifikasjonskrav

Til denne stillingen søker vi en person med

  • erfaring med teknikkene kromatografi og massespektroskopi, fortrinnsvis væskekromatografi i tilknytning til høyoppløselig massespektrometri (HRMS)
  • erfaring med prøveopparbeiding
  • erfaring med bruk av massespekterbibliotek
  • publikasjoner med forskningsresultater i vitenskapelige tidsskrifter
  • ønske og mulighet til å reise i forbindelse med nasjonalt og internasjonalt samarbeid

Arbeidsspråket på Havforskningsinstituttet er norsk. Å kunne kommunisere godt på norsk er en viktig forutsetning både for den ansatte og for instituttet. Vi legger til grunn at ikke-norskspråklige ansatte gjennomfører norskkurs i løpet av de to første årene av ansettelsesforholdet. Norskopplæring vil bli dekket av instituttet etter fullførte og beståtte kurs.


Personlige egenskaper

Personlighet spiller en viktig rolle i hvordan man jobber, kommuniserer og trives på arbeidsplassen. Til denne stillingen ser vi for oss en medarbeider med

  • evne til å arbeide selvstendig
  • evne til å arbeide resultatorientert, nøyaktig og strukturert
  • gode samarbeidsevner
  • interesse og teft for nettverksbygging, og vedlikehold av disse 
  • interesse for å jobbe tverrfaglig og internasjonalt

Ønskelig kompetanse
  • God kunnskap om bruk av KI innenfor analytisk kjemi
  • Erfaring med non-target identifisering av transformasjon produkter (TP) 
  • Kjennskap til EØS regelverk i pesticider
  • Relevant erfaring med å arbeide opp mot myndigheter

Inkludering og mangfold er en styrke

Havforskningsinstituttet mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, nasjonalitet eller etnisk bakgrunn. Havforskningsinstituttet er en IA-bedrift, og vi ønsker å legge forholdene til rette for søkere med redusert funksjonsevne. 

Dersom det finnes kvalifiserte søkere med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV eller innvandrerbakgrunn, vil vi invitere minst én søker i hver av disse gruppene til intervju. For å bli vurdert som søker med rett til positiv særbehandling, må du oppfylle kravene, og huke av for at du ønsker positiv særbehandling når du søker. Du kan lese mer her.


Søknaden må inneholde
  • en tekst der du beskriver forskningsinteressene dine, og motivasjonen din for å søke stillingen. Teksten skal ikke overstige en A4-side.
  • fullt navn og kontaktopplysninger til to eller tre referanser, fortrinnsvis hovedveileder fra doktorgrad, og/eller referanser fra andre nylige ansettelsesforhold
  • CV, karakterutskrifter og vitnemål, samt relevante attester
  • eventuell liste over vitenskapelige publikasjoner

Alle dokumenter må enten være på et skandinavisk språk, eller på engelsk. Kandidater med dokumentasjon fra utenlandske institusjoner må legge ved institusjonens karaktersystemforklaring.


Vi tilbyr:
  • mulighet til å jobbe i en av Europas ledende marine forskningsinstitusjoner
  • et kreativt arbeidsmiljø
  • lokaler sentralt i Bergen
  • fleksitidsordning
  • offentlig tjenestepensjon gjennom Statens pensjonskasse
  • bedriftshytter, treningsfasiliteter og andre velferdsgoder

Ytterligere informasjon

Stillingen lønnes som 1109/1110 forsker, i samsvar med hovedtariffavtalene i staten, avhengig av dine kvalifikasjoner og stillingens egenskaper. Fra lønnen trekkes det 2 % innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.

Søknad sendes elektronisk via Jobbnorge. 

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjorte, selv om søker har bedt om å være unntatt søkerlisten. Søker vil bli orientert om dette på forhånd.

Søkere med utdanning fra utlandet kan bli bedt om å fremlegge NOKUT-godkjennelse av denne. Som søker kan du bli bedt om å godkjenne at Havforskningsinstituttet gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk.

Havforskningsinstituttet er underlagt regelverket for eksportkontroll. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Havforskningsinstituttet (HI) er ett av de største marine forskningsinstituttene i Europa, med vel tusen ansatte, en rekke forskningsfasiliteter og laboratorier av høy internasjonal standard. Hovedaktivitetene våre er forskning, rådgivning og overvåkning. Havforskningsinstituttet eier og drifter seks forskningsfartøy. Hovedkontoret vårt ligger i Bergen. Vi har også avdeling i Tromsø, og forskningsstasjoner i Matre, Austevoll og Flødevigen.

Havforskningsinstituttet skal være en ledende kunnskapsleverandør for å sikre en bærekraftig forvaltning av ressursene i de marine økosystemene, både nasjonalt og internasjonalt, og for hele kjeden fra hav til mat, inkludert det marine miljøet, fiskeernæring og trygg og sunn sjømat.

Arbetet är varierande och innebär både självständigt ansvar och nära samarbete med kollegor. Du kommer att arbeta med olika typer av tekniska och mekaniska problem, där noggrannhet och kvalitet är viktigt.

    Övriga förekommande verkstads- och mekanikeruppgifter

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är självständig, noggrann och lösningsorienterad och som har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

    Relevant utbildning inom mekanik, fordon eller motsvarande
    Erfarenhet som mekaniker eller tekniker
