Spa \& Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)  
ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung  
Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Die Reinigung und der Unterhalt der Spa Anlagen (Innen und Aussenbereich)  
Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs\- und Fitnessräume  
Betreuen der SPA\-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich  
Auffüllen von Verbrauchmaterialien sowie allgemeine Aufräumarbeiten im Spa  
Ihr Profil:  
Erfahrungen im Housekeeping oder in der Spa Reinigung setzten wir voraus  
körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.)

- Solides compétences sur les systèmes Windows et Unix/Linux.

- Connaissances en bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou équivalent.
- Bonne compréhension des réseaux et des environnements de production.
- Excellentes capacités de rédaction technique.
- Langue : français courant et anglais professionnel avancé à courant.

- Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
- Excellent relationnel et goût du travail en équipe.
- Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre.
- Proactivité et orientation amélioration continue.

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

Night Audit (m/w/d)

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung grossgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 95 Hotels in 13 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, bist Du für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da. Dabei kümmerst Du dich ausserdem um:

- Erstellung der Tagesabschlüsse
- Kassenführung und -abrechnung
- Bearbeitung von Reservierungsanfragen
- Frühstücksvorbereitung

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Ausserdem zeichnet dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung

Für einen grösseren und vielseitig aufgestellten Betrieb mit eigenen Abteilungen in den Bereichen Dach, Gerüstbau und Spenglerei suchen wir zur Verstärkung des Solarteams einen motivierten Betriebsmitarbeiter.

Das Unternehmen realisiert Photovoltaikanlagen auf Steil- und Flachdächern und bietet interessierten Mitarbeitern attraktive Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich Solartechnik.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Mithilfe bei der Montage von Photovoltaikanlagen
- Montage von Solarmodulen auf Steil- und Flachdächern
- Mitarbeit bei Neuinstallationen
- Vorbereitungs- und Montagearbeiten auf verschiedenen Baustellen
- Mithilfe bei Unterkonstruktionen und Befestigungssystemen
- Allgemeine Arbeiten im Bereich Solartechnik und Gebäudehülle
- Einsätze auf Baustellen vom Glarnerland bis in die Stadt Zürich

Ihr Profil

- Berufserfahrung im Photovoltaik-, Elektro- oder Bedachungsbereich erwünscht
- Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis
- Schwindelfrei und Freude an der Arbeit auf Dächern
- Körperlich fit und wetterfest
- Zuverlässige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Deutschkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen
- Führerausweis Kat. B von Vorteil
- Bei einer Festanstellung ist der Führerausweis Kat. B erforderlich

Wir bieten

- Langfristige Perspektive in einem erfolgreichen Grossbetrieb
- Moderne und abwechslungsreiche Baustellen
- Tätigkeit in einem zukunftsorientierten Bereich
- Kollegiales Team und professionelle Arbeitsorganisation

title: Maurer / Strassenbauer / Tiefbauer / Praktiker (Maurer/in)
description:
Für eine mittelgrosse und etablierte Hoch- und Tiefbauunternehmung aus der Region Walensee suchen wir zur Verstärkung des Teams einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Mitarbeiter für den Tiefbau.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten hauptsächlich auf Baustellen im Tiefbau und übernehmen unter anderem folgende Tätigkeiten:

- Schächte setzen
- Kanalisations- und Werkleitungsrohre verlegen
- Böschungen erstellen und sichern
- Schalungsarbeiten ausführen
- Armierungen und Eisen verlegen
- Betonierarbeiten
- Randabschlüsse und weitere Strassenbauarbeiten
- Allgemeine Tiefbau- und Umgebungsarbeiten
- Bedienung von Kleinmaschinen und Dumpern
- Je nach Erfahrung Bedienung von Baggern und weiteren Baumaschinen

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Maurer, Strassenbauer, Tiefbauer, Baupraktiker oder vergleichbare Ausbildung von Vorteil
- Alternativ mindestens 3 bis 4 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung im Tief- oder Strassenbau
- Gute Kenntnisse im Tiefbau und/oder Strassenbau
- Selbständige, zuverlässige und körperlich belastbare Arbeitsweise
- Gute Auffassungsgabe und Freude an der Arbeit im Freien
- Deutschkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Arbeitsanweisungen
- Idealerweise bis ca. 45 Jahre
- Führerausweis Kat. B von Vorteil
- Erfahrung mit Baumaschinen ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung

Wir bieten

- Langfristige Anstellung bei einer soliden Bauunternehmung
- Möglichkeit einer direkten Festanstellung
- Abwechslungsreiche Tiefbauarbeiten
- Moderner Maschinen- und Gerätepark
- Kollegiales und eingespieltes Team
- Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen

title: Kranführer / Bauarbeiter Hochbau (Kranführer/in)
description:
Für ein etabliertes Hochbauunternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitern suchen wir einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Kranführer / Bauarbeiter. Die Stelle wird aufgrund einer Kündigung neu besetzt und ist langfristig ausgelegt.

Sie arbeiten auf verschiedenen kleinen bis mittelgrossen Hochbaustellen in der Region.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Bedienen von Oberdreh- und Unterdrehkranen
- Kranbedienung hauptsächlich via Funk
- Gelegentliche Bedienung des Krans aus der Kabine
- Sicheres Ausführen der Kranarbeiten auf unterschiedlichen Hochbaustellen
- Aktive Mithilfe bei Handarbeiten auf der Baustelle, wenn der Kran nicht benötigt wird
- Zusammenarbeit mit Polieren, Maurern, Schaler und weiteren Mitarbeitern auf der Baustelle

Ihr Profil

- Kranführerausweis SUVA Kategorie B zwingend
- Eventuell auch Bewerber mit gültigem Lernfahrausweis
- Erfahrung als Kranführer auf Hochbaustellen von Vorteil
- Bereitschaft, neben der Kranarbeit auch aktiv auf der Baustelle mitzuarbeiten
- Sie verstehen Deutsch bzw. Baustellendeutsch
- Zuverlässige, selbständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
- Führerausweis Kat. B und eigenes Auto von Vorteil

Das Angebot

- Langfristige Stelle bei einem Hochbauunternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitern
- Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze auf kleinen bis mittelgrossen Baustellen
- Kollegiales und bodenständiges Arbeitsumfeld
- Zimmer kann organisiert werden
- Für EU-Bürger kann die notwendige Schweizer Arbeitsbewilligung organisiert werden

title: Schaler / Bauarbeiter Hochbau (Einschaler/in)
description:
Für eine grössere Hochbauunternehmung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Schaler / Bauarbeiter für einen mittelgrossen Neubau eines Bürogebäudes inklusive Tiefgarage.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Schalungs- und Betonierarbeiten im Team
- Arbeiten mit DOKA-Systemschalungen
- Konventionelle Schalungsarbeiten, insbesondere bei Treppen
- Allgemeine Arbeiten rund um den Betonbau
- Mitarbeit auf einem modernen Neubauprojekt
- Keine Maurerarbeiten

Ihr Profil

- Gute und selbständige Schalungserfahrung ist zwingend
- Erfahrung auf Neubauten von Vorteil
- Erfahrung mit DOKA-Systemschalungen erwünscht
- Sie verstehen Baustellendeutsch
- Körperlich fit, zuverlässig und teamfähig
- Idealalter bis ca. 45 Jahre
- Mobil oder wohnhaft in der Region Pfäffikon SZ
- Führerausweis Kat. B und eigenes Auto von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend

Das Angebot

- Einsatz bei einer grösseren und etablierten Hochbauunternehmung
- Interessante Arbeiten auf einem mittelgrossen Neubau
- Bei guter Leistung besteht die Möglichkeit, anschliessend auf einer anderen Baustelle weiterzuarbeiten
- Eine längerfristige Zusammenarbeit bzw. Festanstellung ist ausdrücklich erwünscht
- Zimmer im gleichen Dorf vorhanden
- Für EU-Bürger kann die notwendige Schweizer Arbeitsbewilligung organisiert werden

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

AI & Security Innovation

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.
•    Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies.
•    Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies.
•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.
•    Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes.

5. Compliance & EHS
•    Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements.
•    Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements.
•    Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements.  

Your Profile:

•    Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field.
•    At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment.  
•    Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations.
•    English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above.
•    Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities.
•    Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities.
•    Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
•    Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies.  
•    Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements.
•    Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset.
•    Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.  
•    Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes.

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients.

title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
description:
Company Description

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine, and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist (m/f/d) with deep expertise in developing multi-omics data integration and machine learnings methods, to join our Digital & Data Science Group in Biologicals Research. Biologicals research discovers, characterizes, optimizes and produces novel biologicals. Biologicals are derived from nature. They can be naturally occurring microbes, extracts or molecules protecting plants from pests and diseases or improving plant and soil health.
Within this role you will work on Syngenta ‘omics data to identify patterns in product performance and make predictions. You will be asked to develop methods to analyze and interpret the outcome of ‘omics experiments with your analytical skills as well as machine learning approaches. Your work will result in new tools to guide selection, optimization and development of novel Biologicals solutions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and implement new multi-omics integration strategies (e.g., data harmonization, feature engineering, network-based methods) to strengthen biological interpretation and hypothesis generation
Apply and advance machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI approaches to extract insights from complex, high‑dimensional, multi‑omics datasets
Curate, quality control, and integrate large scale ’omics datasets, ensuring data integrity, reproducibility, and downstream analytical readiness
Evaluate and develop new data analysis tools, validate findings using a trial and iterative approach, and effectively communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Identify data needs and provide recommendations to scientists to ensure the quantity and verify the integrity of data used for analyses
Work collaboratively to deliver new approaches, share learnings, and drive innovation in digital and data science including technology foresight
Work with R&D IT and software developers to deploy predictive model applications tailored to stakeholder needs

title: Agriculture Mission Lead – Earth Observation and Agricultural Decision Support
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. In agriculture, this includes challenges related to productivity, resilience, resource efficiency, environmental performance and decision support for practitioners and policymakers.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Agriculture Mission Lead, you will spearhead the agriculture focused initiative - the GeoLab Agriculture Mission - within GeoLab. You will identify high-impact challenges in Swiss agriculture through direct interchange with key stakeholders and rely on domain-relevant data and experts. Moreover, you will define ambitious mission outcomes, translate practitioner needs into research and product goals, and drive solutions through field validation and adoption.

You will work closely with other GeoLab mission teams, its Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent Agriculture Mission addressing major opportunities in productivity, resilience, resource efficiency and environmental performance
Identify operational gaps where ETH Swiss GeoLab can create distinctive value for Swiss agriculture
Engage directly with farmers, agricultural advisory services, producer organisations, cooperatives, cantonal and federal authorities, insurers, technology providers and industry partners
Identify unmet needs, operational constraints, incentives and economic drivers in agricultural practice
Translate agricultural challenges into clear research, data, product and technical requirements
Assess user value, economic viability, scalability and adoption potential
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss agricultural needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones and decision points and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with GeoLab’s Geo-Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and analyses of big data amounts - and external performers to drive field pilots, validation, operational testing and integration into agricultural workflows
Identify and mobilise strong research groups, agricultural organisations, technology companies, start-ups, service providers, insurers, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab within Swiss agricultural, scientific, policy and innovation communities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned at field events, workshops and conferences
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support knowledge transfer into agricultural practice.
In summary, you understand the realities of agricultural practice and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research, Earth observation data and data-driven technologies into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in agricultural sciences, agronomy, crop science, agricultural engineering, environmental sciences or related fields
Several years of experience applied research, program delivery or operational implementation, in agricultural practice, advisory services, agri-technology, public administration or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding in agricultural practice, production systems, agronomy and crop management
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse practitioners, public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organization. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, scalability and public value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong relevance for Swiss agriculture and with broad international impact due to the learnings from it
A dynamic, interdisciplinary and entrepreneurial environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich and particularly ETH Zurich I Space
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national competence centre for Earth observation
A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

title: IBU Access & Value Lead - Orexin Franchise
description:
About the Role:
- Brands in-scope: Oveporexton
- Be an active member of the Takeda’s access community and value chain that ensure patients have access to innovative treatments ensuring timely, sustainable reimbursement and uptake through robust payer value propositions, evidence generation, HTA readiness, and effective cross-functional delivery.
- Work very closely with Global Access Strategy team to ensure execution within IBU.
- Lead and own IBU access strategy, provide strategic inputs for 6 core markets, and execute market access readiness across international markets for Oveporexton. Ensure integrating disease‑area insights, payer expectations, competitive intelligence, and evidence‑generation requirements to inform IBU decisions and maximize patient access in international markets.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Be part of Global Pricing and Access (GPA) function, contributing to advance GPA governance and ways of working, to influencing functional excellence (Access, Pricing, cross‑TA collaboration, capability building) and to shaping the access vision and capability roadmap.

How you will contribute:
IBU - Oveporexton Access Business Partner
- Plan and execute initiatives across IBU markets to ensure the global access and pricing strategy’s success of Oveporexton in a competitive, highly regulated environment.
- Serve as primary point of contact for IBU Local Access teams for Oveporexton; drive access and pricing strategy execution to enable timely patient access, including P&R success through strong HTA readiness and payer negotiation preparedness, as well as sustained value maximization across life cycle management.
- Partner with LOCs to set the right ambition for LOCs and guide the LOCs with the scenario planning and access plan development to maximize access opportunities. Provide hands-on guidance for priority markets and high-stakes negotiations.
- Support LOCs directly for their value proposition development, negotiation preparation, competitive response, and complex payer interactions.
- Support contracting / access levers where relevant (e.g., VBC, Entry agreements, business cases development, patient support approaches), aligned to compliance requirements and corporate governance.
- Ensure reporting and transparency of access strategy execution and pricing actions, reimbursement status, payer risks, and readiness KPIs for senior leadership.
- Develop an updated IBU access strategy by systematically integrating key insights from leading international congresses and external payer forums within the relevant therapeutic area.
- Proactively foster a growth mindset across and beyond P&R/HTA requirements by encouraging Takeda’s access community to engage with the broader external healthcare ecosystem, including patient voice and services, medical partners to leverage further real-world evidence (RWE) and data generation initiatives, publication planning, to adopt digitalization opportunities, and to systematically apprehend evolving legislative developments.
- Manage and coordinate budget for assigned assets.

GPA / Global Collaboration
- Work closely with Global Pricing & Access Strategy teams to support Pricing & Access optimization by developing analysis, contributing to pricing research, and ensuring P&R guidance is implemented consistently across the IBU.
- Anticipate LOE, biosimilar/generic impact, expansion of indication, external pressure, and competitive responses unique to the TA working closely with the LOE offices.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Connect local, IBU, and global teams to strengthen the value proposition through fit‑for‑purpose deliverables (e.g., value dossiers, health economic evidence, objection handler, negotiation playbook, training) that improve value perception and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across markets.
- Collaborate with medical and evidence generation / HEOR teams to identify evidence gaps and integrate timely access needs within the evidence strategy, ensuring new clinical data and RWE strengthens payer value narratives (contributing to business cases to support prioritization of evidence generation as needed).

Future Readiness / capability
- Monitor and interpret market access trends, reimbursement policy changes, and coverage decisions; identify payer evidence gaps; and translate insights into actions on emerging opportunities and risks, in partnership with GPA access strategy and pipeline teams.
- Lead a multi‑layer TA Access function across the IBU to ensure cross‑market consistency, execution excellence, share practices and accelerated access outcomes; define TA‑specific capabilities and implement the agreed operating model in partnership with Global Access, Global Pricing, IBU Medical, MCE, and IBU Regulatory.
- Equip, guide and train local teams/partners with processes, standards, tools, and decision frameworks to build high-quality LOCs access excellence in execution.
-Lead and be a role model to digital capability adoption throughout the access community
- Develop and run mock negotiations within the specific TA and orchestrate capability training, and simulation exercises for markets.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across GPA teams, access and cross-functions and geographies partners.
- Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives sponsored by the GPA function or Takeda, broadening organizational impact, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and driving enterprise value (mAI access – CXF – JHTA – VBHC ...)

Skills:
- Solid experience in Local and preferably Regional Market Access & Pricing, with demonstrated leadership across TA areas and complex payer environments.
- Proven ability to shape TA‑level access strategy across the full asset lifecycle (launch, inline, LOE), including advisory to senior governance bodies.
- Deep knowledge of global payer systems, reimbursement pathways and pricing dynamics, particularly across Europe and Intercontinental markets.
- Strong portfolio readiness expertise, including payer scenario planning, pricing insights & trends, evidence requirements, and competitive access risk management.
- Advanced capability to integrate clinical, HEOR, RWE and competitive insights into clear payer value propositions and access decision‑making.
- Demonstrated matrix leadership, working effectively with Global Access, Pricing, Medical, Regulatory and Commercial partners and being at ease to navigate a complex matrix of multi stakeholders.
- Project/program management and prioritization capability across parallel workstreams and deadlines.
- People and capability cross-functional influencing experience, including leading multi‑layer, geographically dispersed Access teams and driving functional capability development.
- Learning agility to adapt to new assets within the assigned TA, portfolio or any new situation, continuing to lead within changes and uncertainties and deliver results.
- Strategic thinking: Ability to think strategically and make sound, forward-looking decisions, based on strong business acumen to identify challenges and opportunities and drive impact.
- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.
- Resilience with ambiguity and cross-cultural collaboration across international markets/partners.
- Digital and AI-forward: Experience leveraging digital platforms, data analytics, and AI-driven tools to enhance decision-making and access strategy execution is a plus

title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Production Chimique
description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
•    On-site company restaurant

title: Gasoline Blending Operator #R-018360#
employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:

title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
description:

Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.

\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen

You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen

Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. description:

Senior Payroll Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover) (m/f/d; 80\-100%; 10 months)  
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine auf 10 Monate befristete Mutterschaftsvertretung, idealerweise mit Start per 1\. November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Sie stellen eine korrekte, gesetzeskonforme und termingerechte Payroll über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sicher und fungieren als Subject Expert für Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, HR, Finance und externen Stellen beraten Sie zu payrollrelevanten Themen, treiben Prozessverbesserungen voran und stellen die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Audits sowie die Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie eine umfassende Übergabe durch die aktuelle Stelleninhaberin gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Funktion.  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.  
Hauptansprechpartner/in für externe Stakeholder (bspw. Sozialversicherungen)  
Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.  
Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.  
Verantwortung für interne und externe Payroll\-Audits als zentrale Ansprechperson seitens HR sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten und korrekten Bereitstellung von Dokumentationen, Daten und Abstimmungen.

Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in Kombination mit einem Diplom als «HR Fachmann / Fachfrau» oder «Sozialversicherungsfachmann / Sozialversicherungsfachfrau» oder Payroll Experte.  
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung in SAP HCM.  
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Sozialversicherungs\-, Steuer\- und Arbeitsrecht.  
Gute Kenntnisse in Workday und SAP HCM.  
Sehr gute Excel\-Kenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten für Payroll\-Reporting, Abstimmungen und Datenvalidierungen.  
Hohe Genauigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.  
Fähigkeit, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen, Verbesserungsinitiativen voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen pragmatisch umzusetzen.  
Dienstleistungsorientierte, proaktive und selbständige Arbeitsweise.  
Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.

Kantine.  
Kinderkrippe.  
modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.  
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.  
Home\-Office\-Möglichkeiten.  
Employee Assistance Program.  
Betriebliche Sozialberatung.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
In this role, you will join Accelleron on a 10\-month maternity leave cover assignment, ideally starting on November 1, and independently manage Swiss payroll operations for more than 1,000 employees. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle while acting as the subject expert for payroll, time \& absence, social security and tax matters. In close collaboration with employees, managers, HR, Finance and external institutions, you will provide expert guidance, drive continuous process improvements and ensure successful payroll audits and regulatory compliance. A structured onboarding and comprehensive handover from the current role holder will be provided to ensure a smooth transition into the role.

Independently execute the monthly payroll process for a workforce of over 1,000 employees in Switzerland.  
Ensure accurate and timely salary payments, payroll accounting, salary statements and year\-end activities.  
Maintain and validate payroll\-relevant employee, organizational and compensation data to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle.  
Manage payroll\-related activities within Workday, SAP and connected HR systems.

Several years of hands\-on experience in Swiss payroll processing in SAP HCM.

Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities for payroll reporting, reconciliations and data validation.  
Strong attention to detail and high standards regarding accuracy and confidentiality.  
Strong ability to identify improvement opportunities, drive initiatives and implement process enhancements in a structured and pragmatic manner.  
Service\-oriented, proactive and able to work independently in a dynamic environment.  
Fluent in German and English.
